g.text: 42 782 NEAs from the JPL Small-Body Database (19 Oct 2026). Idealised two-impulse transfer from a 400 km orbit to the asteroid's aphelion, plane change split optimally; phasing and launch windows ignored.
Size from absolute magnitude H (≤ 22 ≈ 140 m, ≤ 17.75 ≈ 1 km, albedo 0.14). Real missions usually need more Δv; Earth and lunar flybys can reduce it.
